raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`DefaultModelLoader` filters MTP checkpoint weights when `draft_model_idx` is set (`_filter_mtp_weights` in `python/sglang/srt/model_loader/loader.py`): it keeps only the requested MTP layer, remaps it to layer 0, preserves non-MTP weights, and yields lazily so the upstream buffered iterator's sliding window bounds CPU memory. None of that behavior had CPU unit-test coverage, so a regression in the filter (wrong layer kept, wrong remap, eager materialization re-introducing the page-reclaim hangs on large MoE checkpoints) would go unnoticed until a real MTP load.

Fixes #47594.

## Modifications

- `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_default_model_loader.py`: three new tests in `TestDefaultModelLoader` (already registered for CPU CI):
  - `test_filter_mtp_weights_keeps_requested_layer_and_remaps_to_zero`: non-MTP weights pass through unchanged (with prefix), only the requested MTP layer is kept and remapped to `model.mtp.layers.0.*`, other MTP layers are dropped; yielded tensors are the same objects (no copy).
  - `test_filter_mtp_weights_keeps_layer_zero_and_multi_digit_indices`: multi-digit layer indices (e.g. `layers.10`) are parsed and remapped correctly.
  - `test_filter_mtp_weights_yields_lazily`: building the filtered iterator pulls nothing upstream; each `next()` pulls only what it needs to produce the next kept weight (a dropped MTP layer is consumed only while advancing past it).

Test-only change; loader behavior is unchanged.

## Tests

- Verified the real `_filter_mtp_weights` (AST-extracted from `loader.py`) against the exact scenarios the new tests assert, with a stub harness (no torch/GPU on this machine): 11/11 checks pass, covering name filtering, prefix handling, tensor identity, multi-digit indices, and laziness (pull counts at each step).
- The new tests themselves could not be executed here (this machine has no torch install, and the test file imports torch plus the full loader module), so please let CI run `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_default_model_loader.py`.

files.patch:
@@ -129,6 +129,85 @@ def load_weights_and_postprocess(self, model, weights, target_device):
                     startup_prefetch_active=True,
                 )
 
+    def test_filter_mtp_weights_keeps_requested_layer_and_remaps_to_zero(self):
+        base = torch.zeros(1)
+        mtp0 = torch.ones(1)
+        mtp1 = torch.full((1,), 2.0)
+        mtp2 = torch.full((1,), 3.0)
+        norm = torch.full((1,), 4.0)
+        weights = [
+            ("model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight", base),
+            ("model.mtp.layers.0.eh_proj.weight", mtp0),
+            ("model.mtp.layers.1.eh_proj.weight", mtp1),
+            ("model.mtp.layers.2.eh_proj.weight", mtp2),
+            ("model.norm.weight", norm),
+        ]
+
+        result = list(
+            DefaultModelLoader._filter_mtp_weights(iter(weights), "prefix.", 1)
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [name for name, _ in result],
+            [
+                "prefix.model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
+                "prefix.model.mtp.layers.0.eh_proj.weight",
+                "prefix.model.norm.weight",
+            ],
+        )
+        # Tensors pass through untouched (same objects, no copy).
+        self.assertIs(result[0][1], base)
+        self.assertIs(result[1][1], mtp1)
+        self.assertIs(result[2][1], norm)
+
+    def test_filter_mtp_weights_keeps_layer_zero_and_multi_digit_indices(self):
+        mtp0 = torch.zeros(1)
+        mtp10 = torch.ones(1)
+        weights = [
+            ("model.mtp.layers.10.eh_proj.weight", mtp10),
+            ("model.mtp.layers.0.eh_proj.weight", mtp0),
+        ]
+
+        result = list(DefaultModelLoader._filter_mtp_weights(iter(weights), "", 10))
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [name for name, _ in result],
+            ["model.mtp.layers.0.eh_proj.weight"],
+        )
+        self.assertIs(result[0][1], mtp10)
+
+    def test_filter_mtp_weights_yields_lazily(self):
+        pulls = []
+
+        def upstream():
+            for item in [
+                ("model.layers.0.weight", "a"),
+                ("model.mtp.layers.1.eh_proj.weight", "drop"),
+                ("model.mtp.layers.0.eh_proj.weight", "keep"),
+            ]:
+                pulls.append(item[0])
+                yield item
+
+        filtered = DefaultModelLoader._filter_mtp_weights(upstream(), "", 0)
+
+        # Building the filtered iterator must not pull anything upstream.
+        self.assertEqual(pulls, [])
+        self.assertEqual(next(filtered), ("model.layers.0.weight", "a"))
+        self.assertEqual(pulls, ["model.layers.0.weight"])
+        # Advancing past a dropped MTP layer pulls it (and only it) as well
+        # as the next kept weight, but nothing beyond that.
+        self.assertEqual(next(filtered), ("model.mtp.layers.0.eh_proj.weight", "keep"))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            pulls,
+            [
+                "model.layers.0.weight",
+                "model.mtp.layers.1.eh_proj.weight",
+                "model.mtp.layers.0.eh_proj.weight",
+            ],
+        )
+        with self.assertRaises(StopIteration):
+            next(filtered)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
